{
  "name": "integrity",
  "displayName": "Claude Integrity",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "Tells implemented apart from verified: a requirement contract from your own words, a Mirage Detector for fake completeness, evidence from real test/build/lint runs, and an audit of completion claims.",
  "author": {
    "name": "NMenzel",
    "url": "https://github.com/NMenzel"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/NMenzel/claude-integrity-mod",
  "repository": "https://github.com/NMenzel/claude-integrity-mod",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "claude-code",
    "claude-code-mod",
    "claude-code-plugin",
    "verification",
    "requirements",
    "code-review",
    "scope-drift",
    "tests",
    "tui"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "notify": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Notifications",
      "description": "Integrity hints: off, important (default) or all.",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "important",
        "all"
      ],
      "default": "important"
    },
    "statusHint": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Status hint",
      "description": "Show the one-line integrity status under the prompt.",
      "default": true
    },
    "paneAutoOpen": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Open pane automatically",
      "description": "Open the Integrity pane at session start (only where it docks as a sidebar).",
      "default": false
    },
    "layout": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Pane layout",
      "description": "auto, mini, compact or wide.",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "mini",
        "compact",
        "wide"
      ],
      "default": "auto"
    },
    "maxFindings": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Max visible findings",
      "description": "Findings listed per pane page.",
      "default": 8,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 50
    },
    "color": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Color",
      "description": "Color status glyphs (glyphs always carry the meaning).",
      "default": true
    },
    "autoCapture": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Capture task prompts",
      "description": "Draft a contract from implementation prompts when no task is active. Never approves it.",
      "default": true
    },
    "retentionDays": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Retention (days)",
      "description": "Idle tasks older than this are deleted.",
      "default": 30,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 3650
    },
    "gitProvenance": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Git provenance",
      "description": "Record the git HEAD with each piece of evidence (runs git rev-parse, read-only).",
      "default": true
    },
    "aiAssist": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "AI requirement suggestions",
      "description": "Allow /integrity-suggest to make one model call per request. Off by default.",
      "default": false
    }
  }
}
